How long does a private speedboat take from Samui to Phangan? | About 20–25 minutes from the pier near the Big Buddha to Haad Rin or Ban Tai, and 45–50 minutes to Thong Nai Pan in the north-east. The pier is about 15 minutes from Samui airport.
How much is a private boat to Koh Phangan? | From 8,500 THB per boat for up to 4 guests to Haad Rin or Ban Tai, and from 10,000 THB for up to 10. Other beaches, early or late crossings, extra luggage and the high-season period cost more, so we quote the exact total on WhatsApp.
Can you pick us up from our beach or villa? | On Phangan we can land at many beaches by sea, including Haad Yuan, Haad Tien, Thong Nai Pan, Bottle Beach, Wok Tum, Hin Kong and Koh Ma, when the sea allows. On Samui a driver collects you from your hotel or the airport for 1,000–1,500 THB and takes you to the boat.
Can we do a Koh Phangan day trip and come back? | Yes. Book a private boat for a half or full day: from 14,000 THB for a 4-hour half day for up to 5 guests, 22,000 THB for up to 10, and from 18,000 THB for a full day for up to 5. You choose the beaches and snorkel stops, and the boat brings you back to Samui.
Is it cheaper than the ferry for a group? | Usually not in fares alone: 10 people pay about 3,500 THB on the ferry against 10,000 THB for a private boat to Haad Rin or Ban Tai. Once you add taxis on both islands, luggage and time saved, the gap narrows, and the private boat reaches beaches the ferries don't.
Can we travel at night? | Night crossings are possible on request, but they depend on the sea and the captain's decision, and a 1,500 THB fee applies before 08:00 or for flights landing after 17:30. On Full Moon nights, book our Full Moon Party private speedboat instead.
How much luggage can we bring? | One large suitcase per person is included, and extra bags cost 200 THB each. Soft bags are easier to pass from boat to beach, and a dry bag keeps phones and passports safe during beach landings.
What if the sea is too rough? | We sail only when it is safe. The captain may switch to a larger boat or land at a sheltered pier instead of a beach, and if the crossing is cancelled for weather you choose a new date or a full refund.
What is the cancellation policy for the private transfer? | Cancel 4 or more days before travel for a full refund minus the bank fee, or 1–3 days before for a 50% refund; within 24 hours or for a no-show there is no refund. Weather cancellations by the operator get a new date or a full refund.
